title: From Ground Trust† to Truth: Disparities in Offensive Language Judgments on Contemporary Korean Political Discourse

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution and consistency of offensive language classifications across six different political news topics (e.g., Presidential Office, North Korea, General Politics) to identify topic-specific biases and evaluate the sociopolitical neutrality of different detection models.

Evaluating disparities in offensive language judgments by comparing predictions from models fine-tuned on pre-existing, outdated datasets (Supervised Ensemble Judgment) against LLM-based prompt variants and multi-agent debate approaches to measure annotation-driven overestimation of offensiveness.
